title: AEW scope correction
description: Register E126 (the operator's order of 2026-11-03; the designer's decisions of 2026-11-03, §2): one exact test path added to one mutating Ticket's scope on the record, with a reason (the typed `resolve` tool, choice `add_scope` or `add_scope_signed`). Written once, immutable, beside the Ticket (`work/<T>/scope-corrections/<SC>.yaml`) and pointed to from its control state (`scope_corrections`). The Ticket's own record is never rewritten.

work_unit.description: The mutating Ticket whose scope was widened.

names_module.description: For a file at the base commit, the stem of the in-scope module its text names there (rule 3); null for a new file.

at_base.description: Whether the path exists at the Ticket's base commit.

created_by_ticket.description: Whether the file is new in the Ticket's workspace: not at the base commit, present there at the add.

signoff.description: A sign-off the stops asked for, as the Lead reported it: cited from a plan revision or quoting the operator. Nothing proves it before the wire.

stops.description: The stops (`test_signoff_needed`) the add met: each needs the sign-off.

unchecked.description: Added paths whose extension the test-definition table does not count.

obligations.description: Dispatch's hard triggers on the widened scope, and the add's own obligation naming the path.

by.description: The actor: the Lead, or the operator through the Lead seat.

generation.description: The Lead generation that added it.

expected_revision.description: The control revision the write expected.

rev.description: The control revision the add committed.

decision.description: The decision record of the add.

stale_invocations.description: Every active invocation on the Ticket whose context pack the add changed, with the commands that re-dispatch it.
